summary: Both arms copy the intent word for word onto the right weekly-view component, but both add a file path that the intent never names.

findings.detail: fresh calendar-views-ui and chain calendar-weekly-view both say "move overlap calculations into the specified utility module (packages/features/calendars/weeklyview/utils/overlap.ts, per the spec)". The intent only says "the specified utility module" and names no file, so the path and "per the spec" are extra detail taken from outside the intent.
